snippet.title: How the World Actually Sees Pakistan's Map
snippet.description:
Did you know that Pakistan’s map changes depending on which country you ask? 🗺️🇵🇰

In this Short, we break down how 5 major global powers view Pakistan’s borders:
🇮🇳 India: Recognizes the 1947 Radcliffe Line. PoK and Gilgit-Baltistan are integral parts of India, meaning Pakistan shares no border with China!

🇷🇺 Russia: Officially backs India's stance on Jammu & Kashmir and rejected Pakistan's 2020 revised map.

🇨🇳 China: Recognizes Pakistan's control over Gilgit-Baltistan (after the 1963 Shaksgam Valley deal for CPEC) but ignores Pakistan's claim on Junagadh.

🇺🇸 USA & 🇪🇺 EU: Show the de facto Line of Control (LoC) as a dotted line and completely reject Pakistan's 2020 claims over Indian-administered Kashmir and Gujarat's Junagadh.


Which map surprised you the most? Let me know in the comments! 👇

snippet.title: How I make Carne en su Jugo! Easy homemade recipe !! Dinner idea ♥️
snippet.description:
🍴Recipe: 
2lbs skirt steak 
1 lb bacon 
Serrano peppers 
Knob onions 
Spanglis asadero all purpose seasoning
1-2 cups frijoles de la olla 
Salsa 
8 tomatillos 
1 large garlic 
1 large jalapeño
Cilantro 
2 Tbsp knorr beef bouillon 
2 cups water 
@SpanglishAsadero @knorr 
Start by cooking the bacon until crispy. Use the bacon grease to cook Serrano peppers and knob onions 6-8 mins. 
In the same bacon grease add your steak. Season with seasoning cover and cook 10-15 mins. In a blender add tomatillos, garlic, jalapeno, cilantro, beef bouillon and 2 cups water. Then add salsa to skillet , plus 1 more cup of water. Add onions,  Serrano peppers and half of the bacon. Cover and cook 10 mins. Then add beans. I added about 1 1/2 cups. Salt to taste cover and cook 10 mins . 
Top with onion, cilantro, avocado, radishes and bacon . 
Enjoy! 
#cooking #foodie #homemade #mexicanfood #easyrecipe
